title: Kestrel and the Harbor
author: Noor Amberdale
blurb: Edmund Blackwood, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. But when the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must get the truth on the record ahead of the victors' historians, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
